claims — the shared claims-gate atom over the sign-off contract (signed-off marker → 'Claims you may use' facts; written by its scoped sign-off, or earlier by learn-my-brand, unreleased)
voice-of-customer bank and demand read — research/audience/voc-bank.md (research-audience), research/market/demand.md (research-market); knowledge_search document/evidence
page drafts answering our briefs — content/drafts/* naming search/briefs/<slug>.md on line one (make-content)
question set, page map and last report — search/questions.md, search/page-map.md, search/visibility/<date>.md (this playbook)
Search Console export, app keyword field, location list, pasted AI answers — human-provided
price history for proxy lookups — research/credits-log/<YYYY-MM>.md via the shared spend-gate atom (all proxy users)
is there an app — Apple's public search lookup and the Google Play store page, via the host's fetch (public web)
rivals' sitemaps and robots.txt for the page-type map; page source of the brand's homepage and one money page for analytics and ad tags — via the host's fetch (public web)
pronunciation facts ('Pronounce "<term>" as "<spoken form>"') — brand_read learnings, if recorded (earlier by learn-my-brand, unreleased); read only, never written here
last run record — runs/improve-search-visibility/search-visibility-check/<date>.md via the shared run-memory atom (this playbook's earlier runs)

managed operation discovery and exact-request quotes when marketing_data_describe / marketing_data_lookup are listed; domain_seo_metrics/domain_seo_overview supply native SEO data when returned; website_traffic supplies total visits only (references/seo-data.md)
writes: the report — local file gooseworks-reports/<brand-slug>/<YYYY-MM-DD>-search-visibility.md (or an artifact in hosted chat) through the shared write-report atom, plus a saved copy with a link (read by the marketer)
search/questions.md — the versioned question set (read by the next run)
search/page-map.md + brand document 'Search page map — <Brand> — <date> v<N>' (supersede) — the cluster→page roadmap (read by the next run and the human; feeds ranked fixes and the briefs)

search/visibility/<YYYY-MM-DD>.md + brand document 'Search visibility — <Brand> — <date>' (keep-history) — visibility report (read by the human, analyze-performance's channel table, research-competitors)
search/fixes/<YYYY-MM-DD>.md — ranked fixes plus a 'For your email program — review requests' section (read by the human, email-lifecycle and the next run)
search/briefs/<page-slug>.md — page briefs in make-content's brief input shape (read by make-content)
optional monthly automation, created paused — automation_upsert (enabled by the human)
research/credits-log/<YYYY-MM>.md — charges for paid lookups via the shared spend-gate atom (read by every proxy user)

brand learnings [search YYYY-MM-DD] — only rules the human stated (e.g. competitor naming) via the shared save-learning atom, retiring the earlier [search …] facts each new rule replaces or contradicts (read by every playbook)
search/visibility/<YYYY-MM-DD>-runs.md — verbatim AI answers, never imported into brand knowledge (read by the next run)

run record — runs/improve-search-visibility/search-visibility-check/<YYYY-MM-DD>.md + brand document 'Run record — search visibility check — <Brand> — <date>' (keep-history) via the shared run-memory atom (read by the next run)

search/audits/<date>.md, search/gaps/<date>.md, search/clusters/<topic-slug>.md, search/pseo/<date>-<subject>.md and search/metrics/<date>.md — selected job evidence and deliverables (read by the marketer, next job run, make-content briefs and engineering handoff)
job-specific run records under runs/improve-search-visibility/<job>/[<subject>/]<date>.md — same-job comparisons through run-memory
